incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A scene of significant structural damage after a disaster, showing collapsed buildings with debris scattered across the ground, surrounded by other buildings and vegetation.

observations.description: A multi-story building is heavily damaged, with its roof and upper floors collapsed, exposing internal structures and debris.
A tall pole stands near the foreground, and other buildings are visible in the background.
A tree is visible in the center of the scene, and some greenery is present around the ruins.
Debris, including wood, metal sheeting, and broken concrete, is strewn across the ground.
